title: Isle of Wight – Massive cuts threaten closure of 9 out of 11 branches.

editorial.text: 351 libraries plus 26 mobiles currently under threat or recently closed (List below “News”) Being the list below represents around a third of authorities in the UK, the final figure could be from 800 to 1000.
